DeepGEMM SM90 MegaMoE headers used by FastLLM's built-in MiMo EP8 backend.

Source: https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepGEMM
License: MIT; see LICENSE (Copyright 2025 DeepSeek).
Snapshot: the installed DeepGEMM headers used by the validated H20 EP8
experiment. The exact upstream commit is not available; UPSTREAM.json records
the SHA-256 of every original imported header instead of inferring a version.

This subset is isolated from FastLLM's existing DeepGEMM linear/SM120 headers.
Namespaces were renamed from deep_gemm to fastllm_ep8_deep_gemm so different
header revisions cannot collide at link time. Include paths are unchanged.
sm90_fp8_mega_moe_fastllm.cuh is generated by
tools/mega_moe_sm90/direct_weights.py from the vendored, namespace-isolated
original header; --check verifies exact reproduction.
It reads the original per-expert weights through persistent descriptor arrays
and interleaves gate/up tiles in shared memory. The original kernel header
is retained for reviewing the adaptation. The FP8 arithmetic is unchanged.

CMake compiles src/devices/cuda/moe/fastllm-mimo-ep8-mega.cu as a separate
sm_90a object and links it into FastLLM. It uses the CUTLASS/CUTE headers already
in this repository. Neither compilation nor inference requires an installed
DeepGEMM Python package, Python JIT, or a separate MegaMoE shared library.
The installed DeepGEMM package is needed only by the independent reference
test in tools/mega_moe_sm90/check_ep8.py.
